correctness.rationale: The corrected theorem explicitly starts with the earlier published exact Gaussian-binomial rank multiplicities. Write N_{n,n-s}=q^{Phi(s)} B_{n,s}, with Phi=(n-s)2^n+(2s-n)2^{n-s}-s and 1<=B<=C_q. Exact adjacent difference Phi(s+1)-Phi(s)=2^(n-s)(n/2+1-s-2^s)-1 is >=2^(n-1) below T-2 and <-2^(n-1) from T+2 onward for T=floor(log2 n), n>=64. Comparison of each tail weight to a window endpoint proves P(|S-T|<=2)>=1-(n+1)C_q q^(-2^(n-1)). Window exponent and bounded Gaussian factor prove total-count log asymptotic. This is an infinite proof using the prior finite rank theorem, not finite extrapolation.

Because image dimension is exponential in retained generators, this is a precise invariant another researcher could need. This value does not rest on rebranding a prior rank polynomial.
